name: Boro
description: Patch laid over patch, each one tacked down with a line of stitching along its edge.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: @pick(2%, 16%); top: @pick(2%, 16%); width: 76%; height: 76%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: @pick(24%, 38%); top: @pick(24%, 38%); width: 58%; height: 8%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 12%, transparent 12% 20%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 12%, transparent 12% 20%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
